sentences.text: on 19 December, 2025  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL
RAVINDRA

SINGH AWANA ETC. Appellant(
 VERSUS  STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH Respondent(
O R D E R Leave granted.

The appellants seek bail in connection with FIR No.790/2023 dated 16.11.2023, registered at Police Station Sikanderabad, District Bulandsahar, Uttar Pradesh, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 304B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
Reason: CRL A @ SLP [CRL.] NOS.14830-14832/2025 1
We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
The deceased is stated to have died at her parents house.
The appellants, who are the in-laws of the deceased are stated to have joined the investigation pursuant to the order of this Court dated 15.09.2025.
Taking note of the above, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the appellants, particularly when the charge sheet has already been filed.
Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside and the appellants are granted anticipatory bail on terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court.
The appeals stand allowed, accordingly.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
